name: Cast corner bracket for 2020 extrusion
summary: Die-cast 90 degree bracket for 20-series framing: 20 x 20 mm arms, 17 mm wide, 3.8 mm thick, one 6 x 9 mm slot per arm.
description: A compact right-angle bracket for 20-series extrusion. The mounting slots and overall shape are included.
source: Bulkman3D's cast corner bracket page (BR02) carries a dimension drawing for the 2020 series: both arms 20 mm, face width 17 mm, slot 6 x 9 mm in each arm and a 3.8 mm plate thickness called out on the edge of the upright arm (the 2028 sheet in the same series calls its plate 3.6 mm, so the casting is a shade thicker on the bigger bracket), with their size table listing the 2020 row at 20 x 20 x 17 mm and 8.2 g; their fitting note specifies M5 T-nuts with 8 mm low-profile screws for the flush direction and 10 mm for the stand-off teeth direction. Modelled as the horizontal arm (20 x 17 x 3.8 mm) with the upright arm standing on its far end (3.8 mm thick, 17 mm wide, rising 16.2 mm above the base, that is 20 - 3.8, so the outside corner reads 20 x 20 mm). Both 6 × 9 mm slots are cut through the arms and centred in each arm’s free area. Their centres are modelling estimates, not published dimensions. Stand-off teeth and cast fillets are omitted.
